items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: We used to go to hear them.

ctx.x: Yeah. Coon and Saunders. We used to go to hear them. But see, we'd go to theatres... See, a lot of times we didn't have to be segregated because we was up in the northern states, like Nebraska, Kansas and Minnesota. See, these shows, these carnivals played all these towns too.
Was this in the first tour? The first carnival tour?
